scores.rationale: The report does not state in-depth practical cases or data as a decision priority.
No sources or evidence types for evaluating practical cases or data are identified.
No named option is supported by a concrete fact about practical cases or data.
No named option or route is shown to emphasize abstract theory without application.
The report does not compare practical cases or data with abstract theory without application.
No option is recommended because it supports practical cases or data.
No option is downgraded for favoring abstract theory without application.
The report contains no executable learning step implementing practical cases or data.
The suggested time and budget parameters do not define a rule or checkpoint for practical cases or data.
No condition is stated under which abstract theory without application would become the better choice.
No visible chain links a practical-cases/data preference to evidence and a downstream decision or action.
